destination_decision.semantics: Public destination must use the exact canonical case. Internal render/source names are retained; explicit destination mapping only. No remote rename or publication executed.

limits: Exact presented samples and proposed layouts only; no whole-overlay or whole-language acceptance.
Documented Pillow versus ImageMagick pixel differences are retained as accepted sample evidence, not new tolerances.
Six language previews retain original font, renderer, layout and historical preflight identities; no automatic current-policy transfer or catalog activation.
Arabic, other unreviewed artwork and the remaining typography proposals stay pending.
English cutover, publishing, merge and deployment remain unauthorized.
